description: This file defines an event subscriber class for handling exceptions within the Symfony framework, specifically for the OrangeHRM installer module. It listens for exception events and sets an appropriate HTTP response based on the exception type.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony's kernel exception events to customize the HTTP response when exceptions occur during the installer process.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically the Kernel exception event, with a priority of 500.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by setting an appropriate HTTP response, customizing the status code and headers if the exception implements HttpExceptionInterface.
